checks.name: only real accounts
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.account_ticket_summary where account_id not in (select account_id from raw.accounts)

checks.name: accounts with no tickets count zero, not NULL
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.account_ticket_summary where ticket_count = 0

checks.name: ticket counts match
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.account_ticket_summary s join (select a.account_id, count(t.ticket_id) as n from raw.accounts a left join raw.tickets t using (account_id) group by 1) e using (account_id) where s.ticket_count is distinct from e.n
